column3: As provided in the Pooling and Servicing Agreement, the Operating Advisor (i) is not required to report on instances of non-compliance with, or deviations from, the Servicing Standard or the special servicer’s obligations under the Pooling and Servicing Agreement that the Operating Advisor determines, in accordance with the Operating Advisor Standardres, to be immaterial and (ii) will not be required in the ordinary course to provide or obtain a legal opinion, legal review, or legal conclusion as part of that assessment.
